For a counterparty, its name must also be in the affected evidence. Name what must happen in condition and compare with an explicit no-change or disclosed baseline. Identify the revenue, margin, cash-flow, or invested-capital effect for the affected business and its direction, with a supported sensitivity or an explicit missing input.
